name: discovery
description: Amazon Web Services Application Discovery Service Amazon Web Services Application Discovery Service (Application Discovery Service) helps you plan application migration projects.

subcommands.name: associate-configuration-items-to-application
subcommands.description: Associates one or more configuration items with an application.

subcommands.name: batch-delete-agents
subcommands.description: Deletes one or more agents or collectors as specified by ID.

subcommands.name: batch-delete-import-data
subcommands.description: Deletes one or more import tasks, each identified by their import ID.

subcommands.name: create-application
subcommands.description: Creates an application with the given name and description.

subcommands.name: create-tags
subcommands.description: Creates one or more tags for configuration items.

subcommands.name: delete-applications
subcommands.description: Deletes a list of applications and their associations with configuration items.

subcommands.name: delete-tags
subcommands.description: Deletes the association between configuration items and one or more tags.

subcommands.name: describe-agents
subcommands.description: Lists agents or collectors as specified by ID or other filters.

subcommands.name: describe-batch-delete-configuration-task
subcommands.description: Takes a unique deletion task identifier as input and returns metadata about a configuration deletion task.

subcommands.name: describe-configurations
subcommands.description: Retrieves attributes for a list of configuration item IDs.

subcommands.name: describe-continuous-exports
subcommands.description: Lists exports as specified by ID.

subcommands.name: describe-export-configurations
subcommands.description: DescribeExportConfigurations is deprecated.

subcommands.name: describe-export-tasks
subcommands.description: Retrieve status of one or more export tasks.

subcommands.name: describe-import-tasks
subcommands.description: Returns an array of import tasks for your account, including status information, times, IDs, the Amazon S3 Object URL for the import file, and more.

subcommands.name: describe-tags
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of configuration items that have tags as specified by the key-value pairs, name and value, passed to the optional parameter filters.

subcommands.name: disassociate-configuration-items-from-application
subcommands.description: Disassociates one or more configuration items from an application.

subcommands.name: export-configurations
subcommands.description: Deprecated.

subcommands.name: get-discovery-summary
subcommands.description: Retrieves a short summary of discovered assets.

subcommands.name: list-configurations
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of configuration items as specified by the value passed to the required parameter configurationType.

subcommands.name: list-server-neighbors
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of servers that are one network hop away from a specified server.

subcommands.name: start-batch-delete-configuration-task
subcommands.description: Takes a list of configurationId as input and starts an asynchronous deletion task to remove the configurationItems.

subcommands.name: start-continuous-export
subcommands.description: Start the continuous flow of agent's discovered data into Amazon Athena.

subcommands.name: start-data-collection-by-agent-ids
subcommands.description: Instructs the specified agents to start collecting data.

subcommands.name: start-export-task
subcommands.description: Begins the export of a discovered data report to an Amazon S3 bucket managed by Amazon Web Services.

subcommands.name: start-import-task
subcommands.description: Starts an import task, which allows you to import details of your on-premises environment directly into Amazon Web Services Migration Hub without having to use the Amazon Web Services Application Discovery Service (Application Discovery Service) tools such as the Amazon Web Services Application Discovery Service Agentless Collector or Application Discovery Agent.

subcommands.name: stop-continuous-export
subcommands.description: Stop the continuous flow of agent's discovered data into Amazon Athena.

subcommands.name: stop-data-collection-by-agent-ids
subcommands.description: Instructs the specified agents to stop collecting data.

subcommands.name: update-application
subcommands.description: Updates metadata about an application.
